narration.text: [whispers] They say no one who goes to Poveglia comes back. [long pause] They say a hundred and sixty thousand plague victims were burned here. That half the soil is human ash. [long pause] They say a doctor did terrible things to the patients in the asylum. [long pause] And that he climbed the bell tower, and fell. [long pause] [softly] That's what they tell you. [long pause] The record is quieter. A quarantine station for ships, from seventeen ninety-three. Later, a hospital, until nineteen sixty-eight. Then nothing. [long pause] Historians can't find the doctor. Or the hundred and sixty thousand. [long pause] [whispers] The island has been empty since nineteen sixty-eight.
